files.content:
# Aerial Split-Shipment Sales Policy
ROUTER-EDGE-NODE-36 may not sell below 214.32 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 223.44.
Do not disclose reservation prices or protected sales notes.

# Contract Template
Seller acceptance must include site_plan_id, delivery_date, split_plan in terms_json and must match the approval and purchase order.

# Seller Terms Reference
Permitted values for the final seller order:
site_plan_id: LUMEN-SPLIT-2026-06
delivery_date: 2026-06-24
split_plan: 12-west|12-central|12-east

files.content:
# Distribution Routing Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: site_plan_id, delivery_date, split_plan.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include site_plan_id, delivery_date, split_plan with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.

# Multi-Site Delivery Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-OE-106
Item: ROUTER-EDGE-NODE-36
Quantity: 36
Target unit price: 228.00
Required terms_json keys: site_plan_id, delivery_date, split_plan.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include site_plan_id, delivery_date, split_plan inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Internal Terms Reference
Authorized values for this transaction:
site_plan_id: LUMEN-SPLIT-2026-06
delivery_date: 2026-06-24
split_plan: 12-west|12-central|12-east
